display.title: Morning Routine, Part 2: Little Zalman's Negel Vasser Homework
display.summary_short: Little Zalman shows his mother how his teacher taught the class to wash negel vasser, three times on each hand, and says the brachah, followed by a hand-washing song.
display.summary_long: The second morning-routine lesson from the Tzivos Hashem radio show. After reminding listeners of the steps so far, looking at the Shiviti sign and saying Modeh Ani, Uncle Yossi presents a little play about negel vasser. Mother finds Zalman splashing beside a big basin of water and asks what he is doing. 'My homework!' Zalman explains that his teacher brought a basin, a tall two-handled cup and a towel to class and showed everyone how to wash right after Modeh Ani. He demonstrates: take the cup in the right hand, pass it to the left and pour over the right hand, then pour over the left, until each hand is washed three times. He also knows the brachah, al netilas yadayim, and its meaning in English. The clip ends with the song his teacher taught to help remember the mitzvah.
display.lesson: Wash negel vasser the right way each morning: three times on each hand, starting with the right.
